title: HiRace: Accurate and Fast Data Race Checking for GPU Programs
problem: Data races in GPU programs are concurrency bugs exacerbated by large thread counts and multiple shared memory regions. Existing race detection tools suffer from high overhead in both speed and memory consumption.
motivation: Efficient and accurate data race detection is critical for GPU computing where massively parallel execution makes concurrency bugs more likely and harder to diagnose.
method: HiRace detects data races—when multiple threads access shared memory simultaneously without coordination—using a state machine tailored to GPU execution's structure. GPUs organize computation into synchronized blocks and warps that reach common sync points, creating a hierarchy. Rather than logging every access, HiRace tracks only a fixed-size summary at each synchronization boundary, exploiting this hierarchy to be both fast and memory-efficient.
key_novelty: Using GPU's hierarchical synchronization structure to compress memory-access tracking to constant size.
contributions: HiRace: dynamic data-race checker optimized for GPU programs with hierarchical state compression
Novel state machine leveraging bulk-synchronous GPU model for memory-efficient race detection
Comprehensive evaluation on 580 CUDA kernels (346 with races) demonstrating improved detection
10x speedup with 50% memory reduction versus state-of-the-art tools and zero false positives

metrics.other: 50% memory overhead reduction, zero false positives
